//rewrites: React Router owns every path after the origin, and the build emits one
index.html. Without this, /admin/decks/<id> is a request for a file that
does not exist: it works when reached by clicking through the app and 404s
the moment anyone refreshes it or opens a link someone sent them.
assets/ is excluded rather than left to Vercel's filesystem-first ordering.
That ordering is documented and would make the exclusion unnecessary, but
the failure it guards against is the whole app rendering blank -- a hashed
bundle served index.html instead of JavaScript -- and that is not something
to find out on the morning it is handed over.
//headers: DENY on framing because nothing has any business embedding this: the admin
screens carry the destructive actions, and a framed admin session is what
makes clickjacking one of them possible.
No Content-Security-Policy here on purpose. This app opens a websocket to
Supabase Realtime, renders PDFs through a worker and draws to canvas, so a
policy written without measuring each of those is a policy that breaks the
field screen in a way nobody notices until a foreman cannot record a bay.
